en.merknad: Requires a Tibet permit and an organised tour; often closed to foreigners Feb–Mar
en.kilde: Lhasa (3,649 m), CMA 1991–2020, via Wikipedia. The Everest area (Shigatse, Tingri) colder and windier

maneder.no: Kaldt (8 °C), sol og frost om natta. Pilegrimer i Lhasa, få turister.
maneder.en: Cold (8 °C), sunny, frost at night. Pilgrims in Lhasa, few tourists.

maneder.no: Tørt og kaldt. Losar; ofte stengt for utlendinger (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Dry and cold. Losar; often closed to foreigners (see events).

maneder.no: Mildere (13 °C). Ofte stengt for utlendinger (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Milder (13 °C). Often closed to foreigners (see events).

maneder.no: Tørt og klart (17 °C). Åpner igjen; Everest-leiren åpner.
maneder.en: Dry and clear (17 °C). Reopens; Everest base camp opens.

maneder.no: Beste måned: 21 °C, klar sikt mot Everest.
maneder.en: Best month: 21 °C, clear views of Everest.

maneder.no: Varmest (24 °C), regnet starter. Saga Dawa (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Warmest (24 °C), rain begins. Saga Dawa (see events).

maneder.no: Regntid, mest nattregn; Everest ofte i skyer. Kinesisk sommerferie.
maneder.en: Rainy season, mostly at night; Everest often clouded. Chinese summer holidays.

maneder.no: Regn, grønt. Shoton-festivalen i Lhasa (se Vinduer). Fullt.
maneder.en: Rain, green. Shoton festival in Lhasa (see events). Busy.

maneder.no: Tørt, krystallklart (18 °C). Unngå Golden Week (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Dry, crystal clear (18 °C). Avoid Golden Week (see events).

maneder.no: Kjølig (13 °C), klart. Kalde netter, få turister.
maneder.en: Cool (13 °C), clear. Cold nights, few tourists.

maneder.no: Kaldt, men sol. Rolig i Lhasa.
maneder.en: Cold, but sunny. Quiet in Lhasa.

vinduer.no: Tibet ofte stengt for utlendinger rundt Losar og mars (sjekk tillatelser)
vinduer.en: Tibet often closed to foreigners around Losar and March (check permits)

vinduer.en: Saga Dawa (31 May 2026, check date): pilgrims around the Barkhor and Potala
